comments.author: @giannisolga5191
comments.text: Iran is an extraordinary country that has contributed so much to human civilisation. Taking a meta view, the west is the heir to the Roman Empire, which fought wars with Persia for 600 years, which may give us an unseen prejudice. The Islamic Empire of the Middle Ages adopted many ideas from the conquered Persian civilisation. Iran didn't exactly have sweet neighbors later - the Ottoman Empire, the Mongols. In the modern era Iran's main unforgivable sin appears to be having huge deposits of oil and gas that it's unwilling to give away free to rapacious foreigners! Iran makes a great scapegoat to deflect from domestic misgoverning, the perfect bogeyman. One could easily despair in our times.
